WITH a AS (DELETE FROM public.resource WHERE path <@ 'projects' AND path != 'projects' RETURNING 1),
b AS (DELETE FROM public.resource WHERE path <@ 'sessions' AND path != 'sessions' RETURNING 1),
c AS (DELETE FROM public.resource WHERE path <@ 'jobs' AND path != 'jobs' RETURNING 1),
d AS (DELETE FROM public.resource WHERE path <@ 'opportunities' AND path != 'opportunities' RETURNING 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM a) AS projects_cleared,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM b) AS sessions_cleared,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS jobs_cleared,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM d) AS opportunities_cleared

INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title)
SELECT NULL, r.name::ltree, 'directory', NULL, initcap(r.name)
FROM (VALUES ('projects'), ('sessions'), ('jobs'), ('opportunities'), ('forum'), ('gong'), ('plain'), ('slack')) AS r(name)
ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING

WITH base AS (
  SELECT id, name, created_at, coalesce(public.slugify(name), 'project') AS slug FROM public.project
), dedup AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY slug) > 1
                 THEN slug || '_x' || left(md5(id::text), 5) ELSE slug END AS label
  FROM base
)
INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, created_at)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.resource WHERE path = 'projects'),
       ('projects.' || d.label)::ltree, 'project', d.id::text, d.name, d.created_at
FROM dedup d
ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.participant_name, s.session_summary, s.created_at, s.project_id,
         coalesce(public.slugify(s.participant_name), 'session')
           || to_char(s.created_at, '_YYYY_MM_DD') AS slug
  FROM public.session s
), dedup AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id, slug) > 1
                 THEN slug || '_x' || left(md5(id::text), 5) ELSE slug END AS label
  FROM base
)
INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, summary, created_at)
SELECT coalesce(pr.id, (SELECT id FROM public.resource WHERE path = 'sessions')),
       (coalesce(pr.path::text, 'sessions') || '.' || d.label)::ltree,
       'session', d.id::text,
       d.participant_name || coalesce(' — ' || p.name, ''),
       d.session_summary, d.created_at
FROM dedup d
LEFT JOIN public.project p ON p.id = d.project_id
LEFT JOIN public.resource pr ON pr.kind = 'project' AND pr.source_id = d.project_id::text
ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING

WITH numbered AS (
  SELECT sv.id, (sv.metadata->>'session_id')::uuid AS session_id,
         (sv.metadata->>'start')::double precision AS start_ts,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sv.metadata->>'session_id'
                            ORDER BY (sv.metadata->>'start')::double precision) AS idx
  FROM public.session_vectors sv
  WHERE sv.metadata->>'session_id' IS NOT NULL
)
INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, created_at)
SELECT sn.id,
       (sn.path::text || '.chunk_' || lpad(n.idx::text, 4, '0'))::ltree,
       'chunk', n.id::text,
       'chunk @ ' || coalesce(floor(n.start_ts)::text, '?'),
       now()
FROM numbered n
JOIN public.resource sn ON sn.kind = 'session' AND sn.source_id = n.session_id::text
ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.resource WHERE path = 'jobs'),
       ('jobs.' || coalesce(public.slugify(theme), 'untitled'))::ltree, 'directory', NULL, theme
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT theme FROM public.job WHERE deleted = false) t
ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING

WITH base AS (
  SELECT j.id, j.content, j.created_at, coalesce(public.slugify(j.theme), 'untitled') AS tslug,
         coalesce(public.slugify(left(j.content, 60)), 'job') AS cslug
  FROM public.job j WHERE j.deleted = false
), dedup AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tslug, cslug) > 1
                 THEN cslug || '_x' || left(md5(id::text), 5) ELSE cslug END AS label
  FROM base
)
INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, created_at)
SELECT td.id, ('jobs.' || d.tslug || '.' || d.label)::ltree, 'job', d.id::text,
       left(d.content, 120), d.created_at
FROM dedup d
JOIN public.resource td ON td.kind = 'directory' AND td.path = ('jobs.' || d.tslug)::ltree
ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.content, o.created_at,
         coalesce(public.slugify(left(o.content, 60)), 'opportunity') AS slug
  FROM public.opportunity o WHERE o.deleted = false
), dedup AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY slug) > 1
                 THEN slug || '_x' || left(md5(id::text), 5) ELSE slug END AS label
  FROM base
)
INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, created_at)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.resource WHERE path = 'opportunities'),
       ('opportunities.' || d.label)::ltree, 'opportunity', d.id::text,
       left(d.content, 120), d.created_at
FROM dedup d
ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING

## SessionTreeBuilder

Rebuilds the **session side** of the resource tree from native tables — pure SQL, no LLM, no embeddings (~seconds, $0).

**Tree shape** (matches the 20260815170000 backfill conventions):
- `projects.<project-slug>` → `session` nodes (summary from `session.session_summary`) → `chunk_NNNN` (stable ordinals by start time)
- `jobs.<theme>` directories → `job` nodes
- `opportunities.<slug>`

**Full-rebuild semantics**: clears the four subtrees (`projects`, `sessions`, `jobs`, `opportunities`) then re-inserts — renames, orphans and `deleted=true` rows are handled automatically. Other sources' subtrees (forum/gong/plain/slack) are untouched; their ingestion workflows write their own nodes.

Also ensures all 8 root directories exist — the ingestion workflows' upsert CTEs look them up for `parent_id`.

**Runs**: manual for on-demand rebuilds; daily 05:00 UTC heal run keeps the tree fresh until SessionVectors/JobAnalysis/OpportunityAnalysis write nodes at ingest (retrieval plan §8.1).
